system.description: The curse is put on a single object within range, which then significantly decreases its traits when in use. The conjured vitner sticks to the object like a foul and degenerate force. Any person attempting to use the object suffers a negative modifier of -2 on all Skill rolls and Situation rolls in which the object is used. If the object is a weapon, damage is also decreased by -1, and if the object is armor, Protection Value is also decreased by -1.
